column1: only one playlist - use the routing chip on the header to add another
column2: yiwet n tbdart kan - seqdec tacrurt n ubrid deg uqerru i urnu tayeḍ

column1: Which cue this master fires on that deck; step off the end to clear it
column2: Anwa cue ara yesnekker master-agi ɣef deck-nni; ɛeddi taggara i usfaḍ

column1: Choose a mask from this show's library, or start a new one from a shape
column2: Fren taɣmist seg temkarḍit n uskan-agi, neɣ bdu tamaynut seg talɣa

column1: Draw on the programme monitor with the mouse or a pen (DRAW). Esc stops
column2: Suneɣ ɣef umwali n uhil s tɣerdayt neɣ s ukelkal (DRAW). Esc yesḥebbes

column1: Going on air takes the cue. Deckboy never sends the switcher a command.
column2: Asiɣel yettawi cue. Deckboy werǧin yettazen taladna i umseqdec.

column1: How long the move takes, each way. 0 is instant whatever the style says
column2: Acḥal i yettawi umussu, ɣer yal tama. 0 d aɣbal, akken yebɣu yili uɣanib

column1: Stop that deck when the ramp lands - the usual take-it-down-and-stop-it
column2: Ḥbes deck-nni mi ara yawed usawen - ader-it-id sakin ḥbes-it

column1: Which of the file's sound tracks plays: a second language, a commentary
column2: Anwa abrid n umeslaw n ufaylu ara d-yettwaurar: tutlayt tis snat, awennit

column1: An oscillator on the colour: depth is how far round the wheel it travels
column2: Amsenkez ɣef yini: tazurt d acḥal i yezzi ɣef tnayt

column1: Rack this cue paused and off air so GO starts it with no decoder spin-up
column2: Heggi cue-agi yesteɛfa berra n usiɣel akken GO ad t-yebdu war aɛetteb n umsefsi

column1: Note, control change, program change, MIDI Show Control, or your own bytes
column2: Tanɣimt, control change, program change, MIDI Show Control, neɣ ibiten-ik

column1: Black behind the words. Zero leaves it over whatever the output already has
column2: Aberkan deffir n wawalen. 0 yeǧǧa-ten ɣef ayen yellan deg tuffɣa

column1: How far the modulator bends the pitch. 0-63, the hardware's own gain range.
column2: Acḥal i yekennu umsenfal taɣect. 0-63, tagnit n usemɣer n uselkim.

column1: the words this cue puts on screen  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: awalen i d-yesskan cue-agi ɣef ugdil  |  Shift+Enter: izirig amaynut  |  Enter: snes

column1: OSC and UDP are fire and forget; TCP connects, so it runs off the show thread
column2: OSC d UDP ttazen ttun; TCP yeqqen, ihi yetteddu berra n usqerdec n uskan

column1: Put the level on an oscillator: Motion makes it a gate that opens as you move
column2: Sers aswir ɣef umsenkez: Motion yerra-t d tawwurt ara yeldin mi ara tmussuḍ

column1: Marks stacked ABOVE the characters, the way combining accents overflow a line.
column2: Ticraḍ nnig yisekkilen, am tiɣunba yeffɣen i yizirig.

column1: Save the mask as a greyscale PNG at the output's size: white keeps, black cuts
column2: Sekles taɣmist d PNG aberkan-amellal s tiddi n tuffɣa: amellal yeṭṭef, aberkan yegzem

column1: Which chime. Cycling PLAYS it, so it can be chosen by ear rather than by name.
column2: Anwa ṭṭnan. Abeddel ad t-yesl, akken ad t-tferneḍ s umeẓẓuɣ macči s yisem.

column1: No rows. + ADD or LEARN makes one; MIDIMAP RESET brings the built-in rows back.
column2: Ulac izirigen. + RNU neɣ LMED ad d-yernu yiwen; MIDIMAP RESET ad d-yerr izirigen n tazwara.

column1: Save the mask's paths as SVG, for Illustrator and anything else that reads them
column2: Sekles iberdan n tɣmist d SVG, i Illustrator d yal ahil ara ten-yeɣren

column1: Which MIDI output; a named port that is missing is reported rather than swapped
column2: Anwa tuffɣa MIDI; tawwurt s yisem ixuṣen ad tettwacehed, ur tettwabeddel ara

column1: An oscillator on the level, running after GO until a later cue sets this fixture
column2: Amsenkez ɣef uswir, yetteddu deffir n GO alamma cue d-iteddun ad yesbadu tafat-agi

column1: Steps in third-octaves, because the ear works in ratios. 1kHz is the convention.
column2: Isurifen s kraḍ n tmuɣli n timirt, acku ameẓẓuɣ yetteddu s ufmiḍ. 1kHz d aqaɛed.

column1: Strikes drawn ACROSS the cell, damaging the character rather than decorating it.
column2: Izirigen ZDAT I TSDDART, ttxessiren asekkil deg wadeg ad t-cebbḥen.

column1: Whether incoming MIDI notes play this synth or trigger cues as they always have.
column2: Ma tinɣimin MIDI ad urarent asinti-agi neɣ ad snekkrent cue akken daɣen.

column1: A note number, or type LEARN and play it. Notes no cue claims still go to cue N+1
column2: Uṭṭun n tenɣimt, neɣ aru LEARN tururareḍ-tt. Tinɣimin ur yeṭṭif ula d yiwen cue ad ddunt ɣer cue N+1

column1: A plain stereo pair. Click to open the matrix, starting from exactly this routing
column2: Tayuga n stereo. Sit i ulday n tmatrist, seg ubrid-agi s tidet

column1: Folding is what turns an arbitrary pattern into something that reads as designed.
column2: Atlaq yerra yal amudel d ayen yettbanen yettwasuddes.

column1: Channel=level, comma separated. Ranges too: 1=255, 10-14=64. Channels count from 1
column2: Abadu=aswir, s tefrayt. Tagnatin ula d nutenti: 1=255, 10-14=64. Ibuda bdan seg 1

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Yessmutti trim n yal cue yettwafernen s yiwen wazal n dB; tira n wazal tesbadu-ten akk

column1: Bends the carrier's PITCH rather than mixing with it. This is what makes FDS growl.
column2: Yekennu TAƔECT n umasay war ma yemlal yid-s. D wagi i yessuḍunen FDS.

column1: Half way through LEARN THE BASICS. Press L and we pick up where you stopped, skapi.
column2: Azgen n LMED TIDDAS. Ssed L ad nkemmel seg wanda i tḥebseḍ, skapi.

column1: Render as a character grid with a 16-colour indexed palette, rather than as pixels.
column2: Sken d aẓeṭṭa n yisekkilen s tnayt n 16 n yiniten, macči d ipiksilen.

column1: Which MIDI output this file plays to; step past the end for the first one available
column2: Anwa tuffɣa MIDI i deg yettɣar ufaylu-agi; ɛeddi taggara i tamezwarut yellan

column1: An IPv4 address, or 255.255.255.255 for the universe's multicast group (239.255.x.y)
column2: Tansa IPv4, neɣ 255.255.255.255 i ugraw multicast n universe (239.255.x.y)

column1: Click a cell to walk it: off, full, -3, -6, -12. This row turns the matrix off again
column2: Sit ɣef tsddart i ubeddel: insa, ččur, -3, -6, -12. Izirig-agi yessens tamatrist tikkelt nniḍen

column1: How long each phrase stays before it moves. Zero hides them without losing the list.
column2: Acḥal ara teqqim yal tafyirt uqbel ad tmussu. 0 yeffer-itent war ma texṣer tbdart.

column1: How long it takes to fall away after the attack. Only audible when retrigger is set.
column2: Acḥal i yettawi uḍuḍer deffir n usekkat. Yettwaslas mi yermed usnekker n tikkelt nniḍen kan.

column1: Off, from start (next cue fires when this one starts) or from end (when it finishes)
column2: Insa, seg tazwara (cue d-iteddun ad yebdu mi yebda wa) neɣ seg taggara (mi yekfa)

column1: Height of one line as a percent of the raster, so a card reads the same on any screen
column2: Teɣzi n yiwen izirig s % n raster, akken takarḍa ad tettwaɣer kifkif ɣef yal agdil

column1: Set slot source as media:/path, browser:url, window:name, camera:name, or syphon:name
column2: Sbadu aɣbalu n uḥric: media:/abrid, browser:url, window:isem, camera:isem, neɣ syphon:isem

column1: Short LFSR mode. The period is brief enough to read as pitched metal rather than hiss.
column2: Askar LFSR awezlan. Akud iwezzil akken ad yettwasla am uzzal yettwasegmen macči d asuḍu.

column1: White, warm, red, amber, green, cyan, blue, magenta. ~ moves it round the colour wheel
column2: Amellal, iḥman, azeggaɣ, aqlaɣ, azegzaw, ajenjari, amidadi, axuxi. ~ yezzi-t ɣef tnayt n yiniten

column1: Re-strike the envelope this often. Hold sustains one note, which is what a drone wants.
column2: Ales asekkat n uɣlaf s waya. Hold yeṭṭef yiwet n tenɣimt, ayen yebɣa drone.

column1: Diamond is the hard-edged Atari Video Music lattice; rings tunnel well with feedback zoom.
column2: Diamond d aẓeṭṭa n Atari Video Music s yiri iqwan; tiwinas d iberdan yelhan s zoom n tririt.

column1: Rock or spin. Depth 1 is half a turn either way; a saw at depth 1 turns it all the way round
column2: Senkez neɣ zzi. Tazurt 1 d azgen n tuzzya ɣer yal tama; amezruy ɣef 1 yezzi akk

column1: DECK playback level (live, not saved with the cue) - per-cue trim is gain in the AUDIO section
column2: Aswir n tɣuri n DECK (s tidet, ur yettwasekles ara d cue) - trim n yal cue d asemɣer deg AUDIO

column1: Still, fade in, typewriter, scroll up, crawl or pulse -- all driven by the cue's own transport
column2: Ibedd, anekcum, tamacint n tira, asali, asikel neɣ tiɣtri -- akk s usmutti n cue s yiman-is

column1: Fields per rendered frame. 1 is one for one, 0.5 holds each field for two frames, 0 freezes it.
column2: Iɣlan i yal tugna. 1 d yiwen s yiwen, 0.5 yeṭṭef yal aɣlan snat n tugniwin, 0 yesgersa.

column1: What this cue shows while it plays: waveform, scope, Lissajous, spectrum, meters or a name card
column2: Ayen i d-yesskan cue-agi mi ara yettɣar: talɣa n umewwaj, scope, Lissajous, aspektrum, imaktaren neɣ takarḍa n yisem

column1: 0 picks tiles by brightness so the picture reads. 1 picks at random so the grid becomes texture.
column2: 0 yettfren iẓelliyen s tafat akken ad tettwaɣer tugna. 1 yettfren s ugacur, aẓeṭṭa yuɣal d tafraẓt.

column1: How far it travels, in semitones. Up reads as arrival, down as departure, zero is a struck note.
column2: Acḥal i yetteddu, s yizgan n tenɣimt. D asawen d tawwurt, d akessar d tafuɣt, 0 d tanɣimt yettwakaten.

column1: An IPv4 address. Names are not resolved: a DNS lookup is a blocking call and GO must not make one
column2: Tansa IPv4. Ismawen ur ttwafsayen ara: anadi DNS yesḥebbas, GO ur ilaq ara ad t-yexdem

column1: Tile width in pixels. Must match the sheet's grid or the slices land across neighbouring sprites.
column2: Tehri n uẓelliw s ipiksilen. Ilaq ad yemsawa d uẓeṭṭa n tferkit, neɣ iḥricen ad ɣlin ɣef sprites n tama.

column1: Alternating mirrors by cell position, which reads as pattern where random flipping reads as noise.
column2: Lemri s umezgun yal tasddart, yettwaɣren d amudel anda aqleb s ugacur yettwaɣra d asuḍu.

column1: 0 welds them to their cell, which reads as engraved. Above it they re-roll, which reads as boiling.
column2: 0 yesseqqen-ten ɣer tsddart-nsen, am wid yettwagezmen. Nnig-as ttwafernen tikkelt nniḍen, am wid yeqqaren.

column1: MONO L plays the left input in both speakers: mic 1 on most interfaces. STEREO is for a line source.
column2: MONO L yessurar anekcum azelmaḍ deg sin imeslayen: amikru 1 deg ugar n yigrudmiwen. STEREO i uɣbalu n yizirig.

column1: The whole gesture. This IS the cue's duration -- a sting is the one generated signal here that ends.
column2: Asmussu akk. D wagi I D tanzagt n cue -- sting d yiwen n usɣel yettwasnulfan dagi ara yekfun.

column1: Click the value to send this fixture or leave it where the last cue put it. ~ makes the level breathe
column2: Sit ɣef wazal i uzen n tafat-agi neɣ ad teqqim anda i tt-yeǧǧa cue aneggaru. ~ yesneffus aswir

column1: FDS is a wavetable bent by a modulator. 2A03 is the pulse/triangle/noise set most chiptune is made of.
column2: FDS d tafelwit n umewwaj i yekennu umsenfal. 2A03 d agraw n puls/akraḍ/asuḍu i d-yettwaxedmen ugar n chiptune.

column1: Scramble which glyph means which brightness. Same set, different handwriting. Seeded, so it stays put.
column2: Semxelleḍ anwa asekkil i d anwa tafat. D yiwen ugraw, tira nniḍen. S uzerriɛ, ur yettbeddil ara.

column1: Pixel sort: runs of pixels sorted by brightness within a row, which is what makes datamosh look melted.
column2: Asmizwer n ipiksilen: iberdan n ipiksilen yettwasmizwren s tafat deg yiwen izirig, d wagi i yerran datamosh am win yefsin.

column1: How many cells the marks may climb. They thin out as they go, so a tall reach trails rather than doubles.
column2: Acḥal n tsddarin i zemrent ticraḍ ad alint. Ttfessusent mi alint, ihi tiɣzi tameqqrant tettaǧǧa ableɣ macči d snat.

column1: cue act val  -  G take  S stop  F fade out (val = tenths of a second)  V volume  O opacity  J jump to row
column2: cue tigawt azal  -  G ṭṭef  S ḥbes  F asader (azal = tikkal n mraw n tsint)  V imesli  O tiffert  J ɣer yizirig

column1: Harmonic weight: a pure chime at zero, brass at full. This is the difference between a ping and a fanfare.
column2: Taẓayt n tinɣimin: ṭṭnan zeddigen ɣef 0, nnḥas deg usawen. D wagi i d amgired gar ping d tfanfart.

column1: Steps through the inputs this computer has. 'Settings input' follows the input chosen in Settings > Audio.
column2: Yetteddu ɣef yinekcamen n uselkim-agi. 'Settings input' yeḍfer anekcum yettwafernen deg Iɣewwaren > Ameslaw.

column1: Embers to roaring. It still surges and settles at any setting -- a fire that does not move reads as a photo
column2: Seg tirgin ar tmes tameqqrant. Tettali tettrusu deg yal aswir -- times ur nettmussu ara tettban am tewlaft

column1: Reference pitch. 440 is modern standard, 432 the common alternative, and older instruments sat lower still.
column2: Taɣect n tewsit. 440 d alugen atrar, 432 d ayen nniḍen yettwassnen, imesla iqburen d wid yadren ugar.

column1: Where the sting starts. Under a voice it wants to stay out of the way; over a room it wants to cut through.
column2: Anda ara yebdu sting. Ddaw n taɣect ilaq ad yettwakkes; nnig n tzeqqa ilaq ad yezgel.

column1: Digital gain on the input, -40 to +40 dB. Set the interface's own preamp first; this is for the last few dB.
column2: Asemɣer umḍin ɣef unekcum, -40 ar +40 dB. Sbadu asemɣer n ugrudem uqbel; wagi i yidB ineggura.

column1: Pulse the size. On its own this moves width AND height together; give height its own ~ to squash and stretch
column2: Sneffes tiddi. Weḥd-s yessmutti tehri D teɣzi; efk i teɣzi ~ ines i usḍiq d uɣezzif

column1: A card fills the frame; a Lower Third is a name and a role, low on a transparent frame, with an in and an out
column2: Takarḍa teččur tugna; Lower Third d isem d tmlilt, ddaw ɣef tugna tafrawant, s unekcum d tuffɣa

column1: Held keeps the last displacement rather than removing it -- the picture stays bent the way the driver left it.
column2: Held yeṭṭef asmutti aneggaru war ma yekkes-it -- tugna teqqim teknu akken tt-yeǧǧa umenhaw.

column1: 12.5 and 25 are thin and reedy, 50 is hollow. 75 sounds identical to 25 -- it is here because trackers expose it.
column2: 12,5 d 25 d izedganen s tenzert, 50 d ilem. 75 yettwasla am 25 -- yella dagi acku trackers sseknen-t.

column1: Quantise the output like the hardware. The steps ARE the sound; smoothing them makes it a synth imitating a chip.
column2: Semtel tuffɣa am uselkim. Isurifen D NUTNI imesli; asefrey-nsen yerra-t d asinti yettɛeggiden aḍebsi.

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB, keeping the differences between them; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Yessmutti trim n yal cue yettwafernen s yiwen wazal n dB, yeṭṭef imgirad-nsen; tira n wazal tesbadu-ten akk

column1: Where the playlist's crosspoints send it (Settings > Audio). Click to open the matrix by name, starting from exactly that
column2: Anda t-ttazent tnqiḍin n tbdart (Iɣewwaren > Ameslaw). Sit i ulday n tmatrist s yisem, seg ubrid-nni s tidet

column1: name values with  d = ...;  end with one expression, or three for red green blue  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: semmi iyazalen s  d = ...;  fakk s yiwet n tenfalit, neɣ kraḍ i uzeggaɣ azegzaw amidadi  |  Shift+Enter: izirig amaynut  |  Enter: snes

column1: Put back what it started from once the ramp lands (after the stop): a deck left ready for its next cue, a swell that lets go
column2: Err ayen yellan di tazwara mi ara yawed usawen (deffir n uḥbas): deck yewjed i cue-ines d-iteddun, asali yettserriḥen

column1: Which speech model makes the captions: English, any language, or the slower, more accurate pair. Each is a one-time download
column2: Anwa amudil n wawal ara yexdmen iglamen: taglizit, yal tutlayt, neɣ tayuga yeẓẓayen ugar maca tseḥḥa ugar. Yal yiwen yettwasader yiwet n tikkelt

column1: What the mask cuts: this cue wherever it plays, this playlist on the focused output, that output's whole picture, or its matte
column2: Ayen tettgezzem tɣmist: cue-agi anda yebɣu yettɣar, tabdart-agi ɣef tuffɣa yettwafernen, tugna n tuffɣa-nni akk, neɣ matte-ines

column1: Play at the screen's rate when it is within 0.2% (59.94 on 60): every frame shown once, the sound up to 3.5 cents sharp or flat
column2: Urar s urured n ugdil mi yella deg 0.2% (59.94 ɣef 60): yal tugna yiwet n tikkelt, imesli ar 3.5 n cent nnig neɣ ddaw

column1: Quarter turns are exact and stay crisp. Spinning samples at an angle, which tears pixel art -- sometimes that is what you want.
column2: Ikuẓ n tuzzya ttwazgan s tidet u qqimen ṣfan. Tuzzya s tɣmert tettḥessiḍ s uɛeddi, tettfeccec pixel art -- tikwal d wagi i tebɣiḍ.

column1: Every take starts the puppetry the same way, so a rehearsed look repeats instead of depending on how long the app has been open.
column2: Yal take yesnekkar amussu s yiwet n tarrayt, akken tugna yettwasizdgen ad tettuɣal war ma tettḍfer acḥal i yeldi uhil.

column1: What aims each tilt: its own position, the picture's luma gradient so characters lean the way the image does, or the cell's hue.
column2: Ayen yettwellihen yal aknan: adeg-is, aswir n tafat n tugna akken isekkilen ad knun am tugna, neɣ ini n tsddart.

column1: Name a channel or a pair once. Playlists send to the name, so a different interface means changing the names here, not every cue.
column2: Semmi abadu neɣ tayuga yiwet n tikkelt. Tibdarin ttazent ɣer yisem, ihi agrudem nniḍen d abeddel n yismawen dagi, macči yal cue.

column1: Click a crosspoint to walk it: off, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Drag it sideways for any level. A playlist with none plays to its own device.
column2: Sit ɣef tnqiḍt i ubeddel: insa, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Zuɣer-itt ɣer tama i yal aswir. Tabdart war tinqiḍin tettɣar ɣef yibenk-is.

column1: Sprite sets installed in data/sprites. Each folder there is a set; cycling picks one and wraps back to none. Right-click turns them off.
column2: Igrawen n sprites deg data/sprites. Yal akaram d agraw; abeddel yettfren yiwen sakin yettuɣal ɣer ulac. Asiti ayeffus yessens-iten.

column1: Internal resolution, 1 chunkiest to 5 finest. This is an aesthetic control as much as a speed one -- the 8-bit look comes from big pixels.
column2: Tabadut tagensant, 1 tazurant ar 5 tamecṭuḥt. D asefrek n tcebḥa am win n urured -- talɣa n 8 n ibiten d-tekka seg ipiksilen imeqqranen.

column1: Picture takes colour from the image. Green, amber and cyan are terminal phosphors. Palette locks the text to the selected hardware palette.
column2: Picture yettawi ini seg tugna. Azegzaw, aqlaɣ d ajenjari d ifusfuren n yigdilen n tira. Palette yesseqqen aḍris ɣer tnayt n uselkim yettwafernen.

column1: SUBTLE self-heals (H.264). CLASSIC is the real smear (MPEG-4). EXTREME is chunkier and smears constantly. Changing this re-prepares the cue.
column2: SUBTLE yessejji iman-is (H.264). CLASSIC d asfeḍ n tidet (MPEG-4). EXTREME yezur ugar yettsfeḍ war ḥbas. Abeddel-is yessewjad cue tikkelt nniḍen.

column1: Sine for line-up, pink to ring out a PA, white to find rattles, sweep to hear where a room rings, identify to walk the outputs one at a time.
column2: Sinus i usemsawi, axuxi i usbadu n PA, amellal i tufin n ṭṭeqqat, asikel i tesliḍ anda tessawal tzeqqa, identify i uɛeddi n tuffɣiwin yiwet yiwet.

column1: Which effect, by its place in the stack of the cue that deck is playing when this fires. With nothing there, the fade says so and does nothing
column2: Anwa asemdu, s wadeg-is deg ugraw n cue i yettɣar deck-nni mi ara yebdu. Ma ulac kra, asader ad t-yini ur yexdem kra

column1: Each frame blended into the next. This is the Hypno signature -- at 0 it is a pattern generator, above it the picture starts feeding on itself.
column2: Yal tugna tettwasemlal ɣer tin d-iteddun. D tamatart n Hypno -- ɣef 0 d amsuffeɣ n umudel, nnig-as tugna tebda tetteččay iman-is.

column1: What is through the window on the hearth wall: a garden, rain, snow or the sea. A room with weather outside reads as somewhere rather than as a wall
column2: Ayen yettbanen seg usfaylu ɣef uɣrab n lkanun: urti, ageffur, adfel neɣ ilel. Taxxamt s tegnawt berra tettwaɣra d adeg macči d aɣrab

column1: BY FIXTURE: the lights in the patch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), by name. CHANNELS: channel=level by hand. A cue can carry both; channels go last
column2: S TAFAT: tifawin deg patch (Iɣewwaren > Aẓeṭṭa > FIXTURES), s yisem. IBUDA: abadu=aswir s ufus. Cue yezmer ad yawi sin; ibuda ttedun d ineggura

column1: Each character rocks as though it were a card being tilted. Every cell has its own phase, so the grid breathes instead of sliding about as one sheet.
column2: Yal asekkil yettenkaz am tkarḍa yettwaknan. Yal tasddart s tifrit-is, ihi aẓeṭṭa yettnefses macči yettaẓlaq am yiwet n tferkit.

column1: Pen: click for corners, drag for curves, click the first point to close (P). Points: drag, click the outline to add one, Alt-click or Delete to remove
column2: Akelkal: sit i tiɣmar, zuɣer i tiknawin, sit ɣef tnqiḍt tamezwarut i umdal (P). Tinqiḍin: zuɣer, sit ɣef yiri i urnu, Alt-sit neɣ Delete i tukksa

column1: The chip's three channels. They differ in kind: triangle has no volume control on the hardware, and noise is a shift register rather than an oscillator.
column2: Kraḍ n yibuda n uḍebsi. Mgaraden: akraḍ ur yesɛi ara asefrek n imesli deg uselkim, asuḍu d asmutti n yiswiren macči d amsenkez.

column1: Scanlines, phosphor bloom and RGB fringing. The bloom is the part that matters -- a phosphor spills sideways, which is why a CRT looks like it is emitting light.
column2: Izirigen n usikel, tafat n ufusfur d yiri RGB. Tafat d ayen yesɛan azal -- afusfur yettfeǧǧiǧ ɣer tama, ihi CRT yettban am win d-yessufuɣen tafat.

column1: Torn scanline bands and RGB separation. In text mode it also corrupts CELLS -- whole rows lock to one repeating character, the way a real text screen loses sync.
column2: Ibaliden n yizirigen yettwacerrgen d beṭṭu n RGB. Deg uskar n uḍris yessexsar daɣen TISDDARIN -- izirigen akk ṭṭfen deg yiwen usekkil yettuɣalen, am ugdil n uḍris n tidet yeḍḍfen amtawi.

column1: Still holds the frame you are on. Flipbook plays the frames in turn. Replay draws the first frame stroke by stroke, the way it was drawn, then holds and starts again

column1: Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Load (stand it by without firing), Arm, Disarm, or Devamp it (a loop plays out its pass and ends); or Stop all, Pause all, Resume all: every deck

column1: Scope shows shape and clipping. Lissajous shows phase and polarity between the first two channels -- a diagonal the wrong way means one is inverted. Spectrum is third-octave bars.
column2: Scope yesskan talɣa d uzgam. Lissajous yesskan tifrit d tbadut gar sin n yibuda imezwura -- adrar s tama ur nṣeḥḥa ara yebɣa ad yini yiwen yettwaqleb. Spectrum d ifeggagen n kraḍ n tmuɣli.

column1: 0 picks the glyph the brightness asks for, 1 picks any glyph in the set. Turn it up to see the whole alphabet: ranked strictly by ink, a flat area picks one mark and the rest never appear.
column2: 0 yettfren asekkil i tessuter tafat, 1 yal asekkil deg ugraw. Ssali-t ad twaliḍ agemmay akk: s usmizwer s tidet s uḥbeṛ, amḍiq aḥerfi yettfren yiwet n tecreḍt, tiyaḍ ur d-ttbanent ara.

column1: Blocks and dithers read as density; the ASCII ramp reads as text; symbols read as wreckage. Cycling this clears a custom glyph string, since that would override it -- the preset row puts one back.
column2: Iblokn d dither ttwaɣren d tazzla; amussu ASCII d aḍris; tecraḍ d iflan. Abeddel-is yessfaḍ azrar n yisekkilen udmawanen, acku ad t-yesseɣli -- izirig n uheggi yettarra-d yiwen.

column1: Equal temperament buys free modulation at the cost of every interval being slightly wrong. Just and pythagorean are exactly in tune in one key. Bohlen-Pierce divides a twelfth, so it has no octaves.
column2: Amsawi yettaɣ asmutti ilelli s yal tagut tettruẓu cwiṭ. Ṣaḥ d pythagore ṣeḥḥan s tidet deg yiwen ubrid. Bohlen-Pierce yebḍa tis mraw snat, ihi ur yesɛi ara tmuɣli.

column2: Nella deg usiweḍ. Ala nekk ara yaɣen imru.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then circle number 22 on the programme monitor. He is the yellow one.
column2: Senned Suneɣ deg umsekyad, syin suneɣ tawinest i 22 ɣef ugdil n wahil. D win iwraɣen.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength.
column2: Aḍeqqes n yimru yessuzur izirig. Amumed yesɛa yiwen n uḍeqqes kan.

column1: Circle him! The yellow one! There's only one yellow one. Circle that one.
column2: Suneɣ fell-as! Awraɣ! Yiwet kan i yellan d tawraɣt. Suneɣ i winna!

column1: Draw as much as you like. Then SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, in the playlist.
column2: Suneɣ akken tebɣiḍ. Syin sekles tugna iḥerrez asuneɣ d tugna s ugilal afrawan deg tebdart n tɣuri.

column1: For next week's show. He will want that circle again.
column2: I uskan n ddurt i d-iteddun. Ad yebɣu tawinest-nni daɣen.

column1: Put that in the Hall of Fame. Next to the turducken.
column2: Sers-itt deg uxxam n yimeqqranen. Ɣer tama n uyaziḍ n yilel yeččuren s ubuṛak yeččuren s uyaziḍ.

column1: Halftime. Click the Deck 1 tab, then SOURCE, then Video Synth.
column2: Anermas. Senned iccer Deck 1, syin AƔBALU, syin Asinti n tvidyut.

column1: My favourite source: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. A halftime show with no camera at all.
column2: Aɣbalu-iw amɛzuz: imeslawalen, imriyen d tuɣalin. Askan n unermas war ula d takamirat.

column1: Halftime! Somebody get me some lights. And a band. And a sandwich.
column2: Anermas! Awi-d kra n tafat. D tarbaɛt n uẓawan. D sandwic.

column1: Select the synth and TAKE it. Then look at the monitor: your ink is still up.
column2: Fren asinti, senned TAKE. Wali agdil: lḥibr mazal din.

column1: Playlist 2 did not change, so its ink stays over whatever playlist 1 shows. Each playlist changes on its own.
column2: Tabdart n tɣuri 2 ur tbeddel ara; lḥibr-is yeqqim nnig wayen tesskanay 1. Yal tabdart tettbeddil iman-is.

column1: Leave the circle up. It's a good circle. It goes with everything.
column2: Eǧǧ tawinest. D tawinest yelhan. Tetteddu d kullec.

column1: A test pattern, a replay, ink on a layer, a still, and halftime. That's the booth.
column2: Amudel, allus, lḥibr deg tissi, tugna tusbiḍt, anermas. D taxxamt n usiweḍ.

column1: Replay in the Draw section draws your lines back the way you drew them. He will love that.
column2: Replay deg uḥric Suneɣ yettales izirigen-ik akken ten-tesneɣḍ. Ad as-yeɛǧeb.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen.
column2: Heddurt i d-iteddun, akud-nni. Awi-d imru meqqren ugar.

column1: Now THAT is a busy play. I can't see the field. I love it.
column2: Tagi d tiririt yeččuren! Ur waliɣ ara annar. Tɛeǧb-iyi.

column1: Two projectors overlap, and each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright. Watch the sides of the monitor go soft.
column2: Sin yimsuffaɣen ttemlilin, yal yiwen yessisḍil iri-s iwakken tafat ur tettwaḍɛaf ara. Wali iriyen n ugdil ad rnun lḥeffa.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and a host who is not here tonight. Press START.
column2: Askan n yisteqsiyen, skapi. Kraḍ n yimttekkiyen, yiwen n uneqqus, d unermas ur nelli ara ass-a. Senned Bdu.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines.
column2: Uṭṭunen n cue, inegzumen, d GO seg yiselkimen nniḍen.

column1: Forty years I turned the letters. Tonight they gave me the microphone. Nobody panic.
column2: Rebɛin n yiseggasen sneqlabeɣ isekkilen. Ass-a fkan-iyi amikṛufun. Ur ttḍqiqet ara.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Amezgun yesuṭṭun cue: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy yeqqar-iten meṛṛa.

column1: Numbers! I know letters. Numbers are letters that went to college.
column2: Uṭṭunen! Ssneɣ isekkilen. Uṭṭunen d isekkilen yeɣran deg tesdawit.

column1: GOTO crosses a long list faster than scrolling. Much faster.
column2: GOTO yezger tabdart taɣezfant s lemɣawla ɣef udrurem. S waṭas.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one is a buzzer.
column2: F1 ar F10, F12, neɣ tanasḍant n wuṭṭunen. Yal yiwen d aneqqus.

column1: Every contestant gets a buzzer. I get the letters. It's fine. It's fine.
column2: Yal amtekki yesɛa aneqqus. Nekk sɛiɣ isekkilen. Igerrez. Igerrez.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Only the key.
column2: War amumed, war tabdart, war tamuɣli. Ala tasarut.

column1: Buzz! A winner! I've never said that. I've only pointed at it.
column2: Bip! Aneɣlaf! Ur t-id-nniɣ ara zik. Ssekneɣ-t kan.

column1: And for our viewers at home: yes, you can push the buttons too.
column2: I wid yellan deg uxxam: ih, ula d kunwi tzemrem ad tḍeqqsem tiqeffalin.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You could host a game show now.
column2: Uṭṭunen, GOTO, aneqqus, d GO seg yal amḍiq. Tura tzemreḍ ad tiliḍ d anermas n uskan.

column1: Goodnight, everybody! Tomorrow I go back to the letters. I'll miss you.
column2: Iḍ ameggaz, meṛṛa! Azekka ad uɣaleɣ ɣer yisekkilen. Ad iyi-txuṣṣem.

column1: And the number is... not three. I'll allow it. I turn anything.
column2: Uṭṭun d... mačči kraḍ. Qebleɣ. Sneqlabeɣ yal taɣawsa.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. For now.
column2: Tabdart tis snat d tissi nnig tkarḍa. Aẓrem yeqqim ddaw. I tura.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio.
column2: Lower Third, isem, takarḍa n uzwel, agilal. Aẓrem yeffeɣ si studio.

column1: That's not my name. It's a lovely name. Now, about that lizard...
column2: Mačči d isem-iw. D isem yelhan. Tura, ɣef uẓrem-nni...

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, an inventor who wants cheese, and a dog who does the real work. Press START.
column2: Aṛakit yettwabnan deg ddaw uxxam, skapi, amsnulfu yebɣan lfermaǧ, d uqjun ixeddmen axeddim n tidet. Senned Bdu.

column1: Stage timers: a countdown over a picture, a hold, and a view for the person on stage.
column2: Imeskuden n uḥerfi: asiḍen ɣer deffir ɣef tugna, aḥbas, d tmuɣli i win yellan ɣef uḥerfi.

column1: Playlist 2 is selected, over the rocket. SOURCE, then Stage Timer.
column2: Tabdart n tɣuri 2 tettwafren nnig uṛakit. AƔBALU, syin Stage Timer.

column1: *checks his watch, then the rocket, then his watch*
column2: *yettnadi s wallen tasragt-is, aṛakit, syin tasragt-is*

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. I have cleared its backdrop, so the rocket shows behind the numbers.
column2: Fren ameskud, senned TAKE. Kkseɣ agilal-is i wakken aṛakit ad iban ddaw wuṭṭunen.

column1: Past zero it keeps going and counts the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Yettkemmil deffir yilem, yessiḍin akud n zyada. D ameṣdaqu s waṭas. D amessus ciṭṭuḥ.

column1: Close MENU, click the Deck 1 tab, then select 'The rocket (lift-off)' and TAKE it.
column2: Mdel UMUƔ, senned iccer Deck 1, fren 'The rocket (lift-off)', senned TAKE.

column1: The clock is on playlist 2, so it stays up while the rocket changes underneath it.
column2: Tasragt deg tebdart n tɣuri 2, teqqim mi aṛakit ibeddel ddaw-as.

column1: We have lift-off, Grommet! ...Grommet? Who's flying it?
A countdown, a hold, a pilot's view and a launch. Bring crackers.
column2: Asiḍen ɣer deffir, aḥbas, tamuɣli n umesrifeg, d usali. Awi-d abiskwi.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a rubber chicken, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Askan n useḥḥer, skapi. Asenduq, tayaziḍt n ukawcu, d yiwet n tikli ideg kullec ibeddel. Senned Bdu.

column1: Two playlists are two layers, and TAKE ALL changes both together. Tonight you will see why that matters.
column2: Snat n tebdarin d snat n tissiyin, TAKE ALL ibeddel-itent akken. Ass-a ad twaliḍ acimi yesɛa azal.

column1: The chicken goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Tayaziḍt deg tissi-s. Senned + deg taggara n yiccaren n tebdart n tɣuri.

column1: The lit tab is the playlist that gets the next cue. Its chip now says 'to Out 1': it is layered over playlist 1 on that output.
column2: Iccer yettṛiqen d tabdart ara yeṭṭfen cue i d-iteddun. Tafelwit-is tura teqqar 'ɣer Tuffɣa 1': tella nnig tebdart 1 deg tuffɣa-nni.

column1: Turnip Top has put the chicken in playlist 2. In playlist 1, TAKE 'The trunk (open)'. Then in playlist 2, TAKE the chicken.
column2: Turnip Top isers tayaziḍt deg tebdart 2. Deg 1, senned TAKE i 'The trunk (open)'. Syin deg 2, TAKE i tyaziḍt.

column1: The chicken is clear all round, so it covers only itself. Watch the monitor between the two TAKEs.
column2: Tayaziḍt d tafrawant deg yirawen-is, teɣṭṭa iman-is kan. Wali agdil gar sin TAKE.

column1: Did you see it? For a moment the trunk was open and empty: two TAKEs are two moments. The trick is reset. Now select the open trunk in playlist 1 and the chicken in playlist 2, then TAKE ALL.
column2: Twaliḍ? Taswiɛt, asenduq yeldi yerna d ilem: sin TAKE d snat n teswiɛin. Tiḥila tuɣal. Tura fren asenduq yeldin deg 1 d tyaziḍt deg 2, syin TAKE ALL.

column1: TAKE ALL takes every playlist's selected cue on one beat. No gap, no empty trunk.
column2: TAKE ALL iseddu cue yettwafren n yal tabdart deg yiwet n tikli. Ulac asugen, ulac asenduq ilem.

column1: The chicken was late. They saw an empty trunk. In magic we call that a trunk.
column2: Tayaziḍt teɛṭṭel. Walan asenduq ilem. Deg useḥḥer, neqqar-as asenduq.

column1: Trick two. Drag playlist 2's opacity fader down to nothing. The chicken fades away.
column2: Tiḥila tis snat. Zuɣer amsellek n tuḍḍist n tebdart 2 ar yilem. Tayaziḍt tettfennu.

column1: Every playlist has its own opacity. Down is a fade out, with no cue at all.
column2: Yal tabdart tesɛa tuḍḍist-is. Asader d afnu war ula d yiwen cue.

column1: Ta-daaa! ...Hold for applause. Hold. Now watch it go.
column2: Ta-daaa! ...Ṛǧu afus. Ṛǧu. Tura wali afnu-s.

column1: Trick three. Bring it back: playlist 2's opacity all the way up.
column2: Tiḥila tis kraḍ. Err-itt-id: tuḍḍist n tebdart 2 ar ufella.

column1: Where did it go? Back in the trunk. Everything goes back in the trunk.
column2: Anda truḥ? Tuɣal ar usenduq. Kullec yettuɣal ar usenduq.

column1: An appearance done wrong, then right, a vanish and a return. Nazdrave.
column2: Aban s tuccḍa, syin s ṣṣeḥ, afnu, tuɣalin. Nazdrave.

column1: A playlist can also sit on any output. Two layers, a great many tricks.
column2: Tabdart n tɣuri tezmer daɣen ad tili deg yal tuffɣa. Snat n tissiyin, aṭas n tḥila.

column1: It's back! Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Tuɣal-d! Tanemmirt! Nekk dagi ddurt meṛṛa! Tayaziḍt dagi i lebda!

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. The kitchen is on fire. Press START.
column2: Askan n usewwi, skapi. Srid. Taxxamt n usewwi tecɛel. Senned Bdu.

column1: Bork! De fire extinguisher is also on fire!
column2: Bork! Ula d assexsay n tmes yeččur s tmes-flurk!

column1: BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen.
column2: aberkan i tuffra, PANIC i uḥbas, TAKE i tuɣalin. Ad tnajmeḍ seg yal taxxamt n usewwi.

column1: A fashion show, skapi. One designer, one runway, and a look she will want back. Press START.
column2: Askan n lɛali, skapi. Yiwen umseggem, yiwet n ubrid, d udem ara tebɣu ad terr. Senned Bdu.

column1: A preset stores a whole look and brings it back with one button.
column2: Aseɣwer uzwir iḥerrez udem meṛṛa, yerr-it-id s yiwet n tqeffalt.

column1: Darling. A look is not a look until you can get it back.
column2: A tamɛzuzt. Udem mačči d udem ma ur tezmireḍ ara ad t-id-terreḍ.

column1: Buttons. Good. I design with buttons.
Store it. Before somebody has ideas.
column2: Ḥerrez-it. Uqbel ad d-asen tiktiwin i yiwen.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it.
column2: Mdel DASH (Esc), syin fren Look two, senned TAKE.

column1: A cape. On my runway. Someone will trip, darling. Someone always trips.
column2: Abarnus. Ɣef ubrid-iw. Yiwen ad yeɣli, a tamɛzuzt. Yal tikelt yiwen yettɣelli.

column1: Recall: the whole look comes back at once.
column2: Aɛiwed: udem meṛṛa yettuɣal-d s yiwet n tikelt.

column1: Thank you. We will never speak of the cape again.
column2: Tanemmirt. Ur nettmeslay ara daɣen ɣef ubarnus.

column1: Simple. Timeless. Recallable. Now go, darling. I have a fitting.
column2: Aḥerfi. Ur yettbeddil ara. Yezmer ad yuɣal. Ruḥ tura, a tamɛzuzt. Sɛiɣ asekyed n yiceṭṭiḍen.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white, and more. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Aḍeḥḥi, asfaḍ, iris, afnu ɣer umellal, d wayeḍ. Uriɣ azgen-nsen. Ass n tlata.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Roll credits.
column2: Aɣanib, akud, d snat n tekciwin n umezgun. Seddu ismawen n taggara.

column1: That is not an iris. ...It is better. I will allow it.
An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Asemdu, aɛwaj, d patch. Iṛubuten qeblen, ad as-iniɣ. Udemawen-nsen d ikaskiwen.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it. The agents did not.
column2: Talɣa n temdeswelt, vectorscope, ini n ddruɣ. Imeskuden frant. Imaẓlayen ala.

column1: Major Tomasina is in orbit, skapi, and her picture has to reach the ground. Press START.
column2: Major Tomasina deg uzzur, skapi, tugna-s ilaq ad taweḍ akal. Senned Bdu.

column1: Pictures leave by cable or network: NDI, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.

column1: Ground control, this is Major Tomasina. Can you see my picture?
column2: Asefrak n wakal, dagi Major Tomasina. Tettwalim tugna-w?

column1: Every way down, on one page. Good. Space has very few cables.
column2: Meṛṛa iberdan ɣer ddaw deg yiwet n tsebter. Igerrez. Deg igenni drus n yiguta.

column1: Sending now. If nobody answers, I'll just float here.
column2: Tura ssiwḍeɣ. Ma ulac win d-yerran, ad qqimeɣ ttuɛummuɣ dagi.

column1: Ground control, signing off. Tell my mother I waved.
column2: Asefrak n wakal, tura mdleɣ. Ini i yemma belli ssellmeɣ.

column1: Ground control can see me! I can see my house from here.
column2: Asefrak n wakal yettwali-yi! Ttwaliɣ axxam-iw seg dagi.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late.
column2: D ṭṭaq nniḍen i tesragt. Amsefrak yettwalin tasragt ur yettɛeṭṭil ara.

column2: Ṭṭaq ameqqran d ṭṭaq yiwen, d ahil s tuget.

column1: ASCII: the selected cue has no text mode (add the TEXT MODE effect, or select a video synth cue)
column2: ASCII: asun yettwafernen ur yesɛi ara askar n uḍris (rnu asemdu TEXT MODE, neɣ fren asun n usintitizur n uvidyu)

column1: ASCII: use ON|OFF|TOGGLE | STATUS | INK | SET | SHUFFLE | PRESET [name|next|prev] | FONT | GLYPHS [chars] | CHAOS <0-1> | WOBBLE <0-1> | WOBBLEMODE [drift|flow|hue] | COLS <n> | GLITCH <a> <b> <c> [d] | PHRASES <a|b|c> | HOLD <seconds>
column2: ASCII: seqdec ON|OFF|TOGGLE | STATUS | INK | SET | SHUFFLE | PRESET [name|next|prev] | FONT | GLYPHS [chars] | CHAOS <0-1> | WOBBLE <0-1> | WOBBLEMODE [drift|flow|hue] | COLS <n> | GLITCH <a> <b> <c> [d] | PHRASES <a|b|c> | HOLD <seconds>

column1: BLEND PAIR: expected <other output number> <overlap in pixels>
column2: BLEND PAIR: ilaq <amḍan n tuffɣa-nniḍen> <amyeḍfer s yipiksilen>

column1: Below the middle narrows toward mono -- which is what a single PA cluster is. Above it widens.
column2: Ddaw n tlemmast isemẓi ar mono -- am ugraw n yimsisliyen PA yiwen. Nnig-is isehri.

column1: Blueshift toward the direction of travel and redshift at the rim. Zero leaves the colour alone and it reads as a lens instead.
column2: Abeddel ar unili s tnila n umutti d uzeggaɣ deg yiran. Ilem yeǧǧa ini akken yella, ad iban am tallunt.

column1: Bright: bright things drip over the dark, as text and logos do. Whole picture: everything is wax, and the picture itself runs down in its own colours.
column2: Tafat: ayen iceɛlen yettqettir ɣef uberkan, am uḍris d yizamulen. Tugna akk: kulec d tament, tugna tessalay s yiniten-is.

column1: Centre is a straight line. Up bends it into an S -- darker shadows, brighter highlights, more contrast. Down flattens it.
column2: Talemmast d ajerriḍ usrid. Nnig tekkes-d talɣa S -- tili taberkant, tafat tufrart, amgired ameqqran. Ddaw tesmeẓẓi-t.

column1: Characters across. Fewer means bigger cells and less of the picture surviving, which is usually the point.
column2: Isekkilen s tehri. Drus n yisekkilen d tixxamin timeqqranin d drus n tugna i d-yeqqimen, d ayen i yettwanadin s umata.

column1: Characters to build the picture from, darkest first. Empty uses the chosen glyph set.
column2: Isekkilen i lebni n tugna, aberkan d amezwaru. D ilem ad iseqdec agraw n yizamulen yettwafernen.

column1: Colour is recorded at a fraction of the detail: it smears sideways, lands late and its hue wanders.
column2: Ini yettwasekles s kra n yiferdisen kan: yettazzal s idisan, yettaweḍ-d d aneggaru, yini-s yettbeddil.

column1: DASH SET: needs a command -- DASH SET <n> <label> | <command> [| <glyph>]
column2: DASH SET: ilaq taladna -- DASH SET <n> <label> | <command> [| <glyph>]

column1: DMXCUE SET: expected channel=level pairs, e.g. 1=255,10-14=64
column2: DMXCUE SET: ilaq tayugi channel=level, amedya 1=255,10-14=64

column1: DRAW COLOUR: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, a name, or 1-8 for the palette
column2: DRAW COLOUR: #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, isem, neɣ 1-8 i tfelwit n yiniten

column1: DRAW TOOL: brush, erase, line, box, oval or fill
column2: DRAW TOOL: brush, erase, line, box, oval neɣ fill

column1: FADE TO: a speed from 0.25 to 4 (0.5 is half speed, an octave down)
column2: FADE TO: arured seg 0.25 ar 4 (0.5 d azgen n urured, aktav ddaw)

column1: FADE WHAT: expected opacity, volume, dimmer, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, effect, audiofx or speed
column2: FADE WHAT: ilaq opacity, volume, dimmer, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, effect, audiofx neɣ speed

column1: FX LFO: on, off, shape, rate, depth, zone, channel or cc
column2: FX LFO: on, off, shape, rate, depth, zone, channel neɣ cc

column1: FX: use LIST | ADD <effect> [amount] | AMOUNT <n> <v> | PARAM <n> <A-F> <0-1> | CHOICE <n> <A|B> <name> | LFO <n> <A-G> ... | COPY | PASTE | CLEAR
column2: FX: seqdec LIST | ADD <effect> [amount] | AMOUNT <n> <v> | PARAM <n> <A-F> <0-1> | CHOICE <n> <A|B> <name> | LFO <n> <A-G> ... | COPY | PASTE | CLEAR

column1: Fields per frame, 0-4 (1 = one field per rendered frame) (supports + - * / and ())
column2: Urtiyen i tugna, 0-4 (1 = yiwen n wurti i yal tugna yettwassudsen) (isefrak + - * / akked ())

column1: Flip across, upside down or both, or fold one half onto the other: right onto left, left onto right, bottom onto top, top onto bottom, or one corner into all four.
column2: Zzi s tehri, s uqelqul neɣ s sin, neɣ eḍwi azgen ɣef wayeḍ: afus ɣef zelmaḍ, zelmaḍ ɣef ufus, ddaw ɣef nnig, nnig ɣef ddaw, neɣ yiwet n tɣemmar deg ukkuẓ.

column1: GEOLFO: x, y, width, height, rotation, cropleft, cropright, croptop or cropbottom
column2: GEOLFO: x, y, width, height, rotation, cropleft, cropright, croptop neɣ cropbottom

column1: How bright a pixel has to be to join a run. Lower catches more of the picture and the runs grow longer.
column2: Acḥal n tafat ilaqen i upiksil ad yekcem deg uziri. Azal ameẓyan yeṭṭef ugar n tugna, izirigen ttuɣalen ɣezzifit.

column1: How faint a gradient still registers. High turns the quietest shading into visible structure.
column2: Acḥal n ubeddel n tafat aẓiḍan i mazal yettban. Azal ameqqran yeskanay-d ula d tili tafessast.

column1: How far back the chain listens. The picture is played through a delay, so this is the distance the damage is dragged across.
column2: Acḥal n wakud i tesla tkerrust ɣer deffir. Tugna tetturar s useɛḍel, d tagi i d teɣzi n ujerred n uxessar.

column1: How far the burn spreads off the edge, and how hot its colour runs.
column2: Acḥal i yettwassaɣ ureɣ seg yiran, d acḥal i yesḥemmu yini-s.

column1: How far the colour turns on each trip round the loop. This is the oil-slick: the trail walks through the spectrum instead of fading.
column2: Acḥal n wannuz n yini deg yal tikkelt n wannuz. D tagi i d taẓẓult n zzit: lateṛ yeḍfer asaren deg umkan n usfeḍ.

column1: How far the picture stands out. Bright parts come forward, dark parts stay back. At the left it is flat.
column2: Acḥal i d-teffeɣ tugna. Aḥric aceɛlal yettas-d ɣer sdat, aberkan yeqqim deffir. Deg uzelmaḍ d tameflat.

column1: How far the picture swings the filter. The cue's own brightness opens and closes it, so a cut to black takes the top off the sound.
column2: Acḥal i tesmutti tugna tastayt. Tafat n usun telli u tsekkar-itt, ihi agezzum ar uberkan yekkes ṣṣut ɛlayen.

column1: How far the top comes down as the end approaches. This is not a fade: the level is left alone.
column2: Acḥal i yettader ṣṣut ɛlayen mi d-iqerreb taggara. Mačči d asfeḍ: aswir yeqqim akken yella.

column1: How fast it settles away while held. At zero it holds indefinitely, which is what room tone under a held title wants.
column2: Arured n usfeḍ deg uḥbas. S yilem yeḥbes i lebda, am ṣṣut n texxamt ddaw n uzwel yeqqimen.

column1: How fast the open slit crosses the picture. Slow smears a long moment across the frame.
column2: Arured n tmerna yeldin deg tugna. S leɛḍil ijerred taswiɛt ɣezzifen ɣef tugna akk.

column1: How fast the wave travels. Faster spreads further in the same time and interferes more.
column2: Arured n umdeswel. Arured ameqqran yettwassaɣ ugar deg yiwen n wakud u yettemyekcam ugar.

column1: How fast what has dripped hardens away. At the left the drips stay until the cue changes.
column2: Arured n useqqur d usfeḍ n wayen i d-iqettṛen. Deg uzelmaḍ tiqit qqiment ar ubeddel n usun.

column1: How fine the water is. Long ocean swell at one end, rain on a puddle at the other.
column2: Acḥal meẓẓiyit yimdeswal n waman. Imdeswal ɣezzifen n yilel deg yiwet n tama, ageffur deg temda deg tayeḍ.

column1: How hard the light gathers where the rays converge. This is the part that makes it read as water rather than as a wobble.
column2: Acḥal i tettjemmaɛ tafat anda mlalen yiẓerẓuren. D aya i t-yesbanen am waman deg umkan n uhezzan.

column1: How hard the moving parts throw sand. More shake clears the plate faster and makes the lines thinner.
column2: Acḥal n tezmert i sseqḍaɛen yiḥricen imuttiyen ijdi. Ugar n uhezzan yesfaḍ tafelwit s zzerb u yesseḍraq izirigen.

column1: How long a grain is, in VIDEO FRAMES. On a 23.976 clip one frame is 41.7ms, which is not a musical value and is exactly the point.
column2: Teɣzi n uɛeqqa, s TUGNIWIN N UVIDYU. Deg taɣerɣert 23.976, yiwet n tugna d 41.7ms, mačči d azal aẓawan, d aya i d iswi.

column1: How long before the end it starts. The cue has to have a known length -- an open-ended one has no end to resolve into.
column2: Acḥal n wakud send taggara i yettnekker. Ilaq asun s teɣzi yettwassnen -- win ur yesɛin ara taggara ulac anda ara yefru.

column1: How long the old waves linger when the note changes. Left: they die at once. Right: they slosh for a while.
column2: Acḥal n wakud qqimen yimdeswal iqburen mi tbeddel tẓẓelt. Zelmaḍ: mmetten din din. Afus: tthezzin kra n wakud.

column1: How much each facet catches the light, which is what makes them read as faceted rather than as flat blobs.
column2: Acḥal i teṭṭef yal tama tafat, i wakken ad banent d tiɣemmar deg umkan n tlɣiwin timeflatin.

column1: How much its SIZE becomes distance. Shrink the picture and the sound goes away from you: the top comes off, the image narrows, the level drops.
column2: Acḥal teqqen TEƔZI-s ɣer umecwar. Smeẓẓi tugna, ṣṣut yettbeɛɛid: ṣṣut ɛlayen yettader, tugna n ṣṣut teḍreq, aswir yettader.

column1: How much of the bent picture goes round again. High is where it stops being an echo and starts eating itself.
column2: Acḥal n tugna yeknan i d-yettuɣalen. Deg wazal ameqqran ur d-yettuɣal ara d aṣṣeḍ, yettett iman-is.

column1: How much of the driver's movement the picture KEEPS. At zero it follows the driver frame by frame, which is a twitch. Wind it up and the motion accumulates, so the driver sculpts the picture over time and it holds the pose -- which is what puppetry means.
column2: Acḥal n umutti n umaway i TETTAṬṬAF tugna. S yilem teṭṭafar-it tugna s tugna, d aneḥḥez. Snerni-t ad yemlil umutti, amaway ad yesseɣti tugna s wakud u ad teqqim deg umkan-is -- am uẓḍi n tmucuha.

column1: How much of the picture's position on the output is used. A PIP on the left sounds on the left -- and it is a placement, not a pan: the far ear gets the delay and the head shadow too.
column2: Acḥal n wadeg n tugna deg tuffɣa i yettwasqedcen. PIP deg uzelmaḍ yessawal deg uzelmaḍ -- d asers, mačči d pan: ula d ameẓẓuɣ ibeɛden yeṭṭef aɛeṭṭel d tili n uqerru.

column1: How much of the tail is kept going while the cue is held. Long enough to hide the splice in room tone, short enough not to smear a rhythm in it.
column2: Acḥal n taggara n ṣṣut i yeqqimen deg uḥbas n usun. Ɣezzif akken ad ifer aẓeṭṭa n ṣṣut n texxamt, wezzil akken ur yessebzeg ara aẓawan.

column1: How much room comes up under it, so the sound settles into the cut instead of being severed.
column2: Acḥal n ṣṣut n texxamt i d-yettalin ddaw-as, i wakken ṣṣut ad yeqqim deg ugezzum deg umkan ad yegzem dγa.

column1: How much the echo is distorted each pass. It compounds, so a little ripples and a lot melts the picture into itself.
column2: Acḥal i yettusexser uṣṣeḍ deg yal tikkelt. Yettemlil, kra d imdeswal, ugar yesfsi tugna deg yiman-is.

column1: How much the material draws in towards each drip, so it runs as a thin neck with a heavier head.
column2: Acḥal i tettagem tilɣa ar yal tiqqit, i wakken ad tezzel s uɛenqiq awezlan d uqerru ẓẓayen.

column1: How often its settings are corrupted. Corrupted far enough it oscillates on its own -- loud, but it cannot run away.
column2: Acḥal n tikkal ttxessiren yiɣewwaren. Ma xessren aṭas ad tthezzin s yiman-nsen -- ṣṣut ɛlayen, maca ur izmir ara ad yeflet.

column1: How quickly the picture springs back to rest once the driver stops pushing it. Only does anything when memory is up.
column2: Arured n tuɣalin n tugna ar uḥbas mi yeḥbes umaway ad tt-ideg. Ixeddem kan mi yella ummekti ɛlayen.

column1: How small a cut sets it off. With no picture it runs on a timer instead, and this is how often.
column2: Acḥal meẓẓiy agezzum i t-yessekren. Ma ulac tugna yetturar s umsizwer n wakud, d tagi i d tifrat.

column1: How strongly the finished picture pushes the bend. Pair it with a picture effect whose LFO is set to Audio and the two drive each other.
column2: Acḥal n tezmert i s tesdeggir tugna yemden aseɣti. Qqen-it ɣer usemdu n tugna s LFO ɣef Ameslaw, ad myesdeggren sin.

column1: LFO: density, speed, warp, turn, centrex, centrey, grey or hue
column2: LFO: density, speed, warp, turn, centrex, centrey, grey neɣ hue

column1: Lift or cut, 12dB either way. The centre is flat, so a band that has just been added does nothing until this is moved.
column2: Snerni neɣ senɣes, 12dB i yal tama. Talemmast d tameflat, aḥzam amaynut ur ixeddem ara alamma tesmuttiḍ aya.

column1: Light on the drips, as on something wet: a gloss where it faces the light, darker where it curls away.
column2: Tafat ɣef teqqit, am wayen yebzeg: abririq deg tama n tafat, aberkan anda yettuneḍ ɣer deffir.

column1: MASK SET: expected INVERT, X, Y, SCALE, ROTATION, FEATHER, GROW or OPACITY and a number
column2: MASK SET: ilaq INVERT, X, Y, SCALE, ROTATION, FEATHER, GROW neɣ OPACITY d umḍan

column1: MIDIIN: NOTE <n> <vel>, NOTEOFF <n>, CC <c> <v>, PITCH <0-16383>, PRESSURE <v>, KEYPRESSURE <n> <v>, PROGRAM <n> or OSC <address> [<n>], then CH <1-16> if not channel 1
column2: MIDIIN: NOTE <n> <vel>, NOTEOFF <n>, CC <c> <v>, PITCH <0-16383>, PRESSURE <v>, KEYPRESSURE <n> <v>, PROGRAM <n> neɣ OSC <address> [<n>], syen CH <1-16> ma mačči d abadu 1

column1: MIDIMAP: LIST, ADD, SET, REMOVE, CLEAR, RESET, LEARN, LEARNED, PRESET or FEEDBACK
column2: MIDIMAP: LIST, ADD, SET, REMOVE, CLEAR, RESET, LEARN, LEARNED, PRESET neɣ FEEDBACK

column1: MULTIVIEW WINDOW <n>: expected a source, or SAFE/METER/LABEL ON|OFF
column2: MULTIVIEW WINDOW <n>: ilaq aɣbalu, neɣ SAFE/METER/LABEL ON|OFF

column1: Moves the direction of travel off the centre of frame, so the picture rushes past rather than straight at you.
column2: Yesmutti tanila n umutti seg tlemmast n tugna, i wakken tugna ad tɛeddi seg yidis-ik deg umkan ad d-tas srid ɣur-k.

column1: N=new  Enter/P=previous  O=open saved  E=examples  L=learn  1-
column2: N=amaynut  Enter/P=uzwir  O=ldi asekles  E=imedyaten  L=lmed  1-

column1: NMOS: NOT registering - network is LOCAL ONLY (turn REMOTE ON to publish)
column2: NMOS: UR YETTUSEKLAS ARA - aẓeṭṭa d ADIGAN KAN (ssermed REMOTE ON i usuffeɣ)

column1: OUTPUT SPOUT: ON | OFF | TOGGLE | NAME <sender name>
column2: OUTPUT SPOUT: ON | OFF | TOGGLE | NAME <isem n umazan>

column1: One knob for the whole balance: below the middle is darker, above it is brighter.
column2: Yiwet n tqeffalt i umwazan akk: ddaw n tlemmast d aberkan, nnig d aceɛlal.

column1: Original: the picture pulled onto the figure. Sand: the picture as grains that are thrown off the moving parts and pour into each new figure. Fluid: the picture under water on the plate, bent and lit by its standing waves.
column2: Aneṣli: tugna yettwajebden ɣef talɣa. Ijdi: tugna d iɛeqqayen yettuseḍqen seg yiḥricen imuttiyen u ttezzalen deg yal talɣa tamaynut. Aman: tugna ddaw n waman ɣef tfelwit, tesɣiḍ u tceɛɛel s yimdeswal-is ibedden.

column1: PHONE LEVEL: removed -- a paired phone or the passphrase can do everything; BLACKOUT and RECORD are hold-to-fire on the phone
column2: PHONE LEVEL: yettwakkes -- tiliɣri iqqnen neɣ awal uffir zemren ad xedmen kulec; BLACKOUT d RECORD ilaq aḥbas n tqeffalt deg tiliɣri

column1: PowerPoint could not export this file (it may need permission to be automated: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation)
column2: PowerPoint ur yezmir ara ad issufeɣ afaylu-a (yezmer ad yeḥwaǧ tasiregt n uselkem awurman: Iɣewwaren n unagraw > Tabaḍnit d teɣlist > Awurman)

column1: PowerPoint could not open the file (it gave up waiting for it). If it is in OneDrive, right-click it and choose Always keep on this device, then import it again
column2: PowerPoint ur yezmir ara ad yeldi afaylu (yeḥbes araǧu). Ma yella deg OneDrive, sit s ufus u fren Sekles yal tikelt deg wallal-a, syen kter-it tikkelt-nniḍen

column1: Pulls the bright tones down without moving pure white, so a hot highlight rolls off instead of clipping.
column2: Yesnuzul ini aceɛlal war abeddel n umlal azeddgan, i wakken tafat tɛedda s leɛḍil deg umkan n ugezzum.

column1: Rotates the reading, so straight lines wind into spirals rather than rings.
column2: Yezzi taɣuri, izirigen usriden ttuɣalen d tizelɣiwin deg umkan n twinas.

column1: Rows lose sync and repeat one character, the way a real text screen breaks up. At 0 the grid is clean.
column2: Izirigen sruḥuyen amtawi u ttaɣalen ɣer yiwen n usekkil, am uxessar n ugdil n uḍris n tidet. S 0 tazelɣa tezdeg.

column1: SLICE <n>: CROP, PLACE, CORNER, EDGE, MASK, SOURCE, ROTATE, FLIP, OPACITY, LFO, ON, OFF, LINEAR, PERSPECTIVE or NAME
column2: SLICE <n>: CROP, PLACE, CORNER, EDGE, MASK, SOURCE, ROTATE, FLIP, OPACITY, LFO, ON, OFF, LINEAR, PERSPECTIVE neɣ NAME

column1: SLICE CORNER: TL, TR, BR or BL, then dx dy in percent of the output
column2: SLICE CORNER: TL, TR, BR neɣ BL, syen dx dy s tefrayt n tuffɣa

column1: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T or B, then 0-50 (% of the slice)
column2: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T neɣ B, syen 0-50 (% n uḥric)

column1: SLICE GRID POINT: col row (from 1, on a grid that is on) then dx dy in percent
column2: SLICE GRID POINT: col row (seg 1, deg tẓeṭṭa iremden) syen dx dy s tefrayt

column1: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF, or POINT col row dx dy
column2: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF, neɣ POINT col row dx dy

column1: SLICE LFO: X, Y, ROTATION or OPACITY, then ON, OFF, SHAPE, RATE, DEPTH...
column2: SLICE LFO: X, Y, ROTATION neɣ OPACITY, syen ON, OFF, SHAPE, RATE, DEPTH...

column1: SLICE ROTATE: IN (the crop) or OUT (the placed picture), then degrees
column2: SLICE ROTATE: IN (agezzum) neɣ OUT (tugna yersen), syen tifessatin

column1: Scanlines, bloom and gun misalignment, 0-1 (supports + - * / and ())
column2: Izirigen n usken, tafat yettwassaɣen d yimeẓriyen ur nmeɣran ara, 0-1 (isefrak + - * / akked ())

column1: Something near the deck: a phone's buzz, a light dimmer's herringbone, a radio's slow bars.
column2: Kra ɣer tama n udek: aẓenẓen n tiliɣri, izirigen n usenqed n tafat, iḥzamen s leɛḍil n rradyu.

column1: Takes out everything brighter than this as well. Left takes out nothing.
column2: Yekkes daɣen ayen akk iceɛlen ugar n waya. Deg uzelmaḍ ur yekkes acemma.

column1: Takes out everything darker than this, so what lies beneath shows through. Left takes out nothing.
column2: Yekkes ayen akk iberkanen ugar n waya, ad iban wayen yellan ddaw. Deg uzelmaḍ ur yekkes acemma.

column1: Tape speed: SP is the best picture, LP and EP fit more on a tape and lose detail and colour.
column2: Arured n tesfift: SP d tugna yelhan akk, LP d EP sekcamen ugar deg tesfift maca sruḥuyen iferdisen d yini.

column1: The brightness that stays put. Everything above it reaches one way and everything below it the other.
column2: Tafat i yeqqimen. Ayen akk yellan nnig-s yeẓẓel ɣer yiwet n tnila, ayen ddaw-s ɣer tayeḍ.

column1: The character of the growth: low is waves, then labyrinth, coral, worms, and holes at the top.
column2: Talɣa n unerni: ddaw d imdeswal, syen d aẓeṭṭa, lmerǧan, iḍuḍan d yiseɣwan deg ufella.

column1: The colour it becomes. Shading and brightness stay as they were, so a red shirt turns blue and keeps its folds.
column2: Ini i tettuɣal. Tili d tafat qqiment, ihi aqendur azeggaɣ yettuɣal d anili u yeṭṭef iḍewlan-is.

column1: The distance that sits ON the screen. Either side of it comes forward or falls behind.
column2: Amecwar i yellan ƔEF ugdil. Deg yal tama yettas-d ɣer sdat neɣ yettuɣal ɣer deffir.

column1: The frequency it pivots around -- what counts as 'low' and 'high' for the tilt.
column2: Talɣut i d-yettuzzin fell-as -- ayen i d 'ddaw' d 'nnig' i usenneḍ.

column1: The level below which the source is closed. Set it under the quietest thing you want to hear.
column2: Aswir ddaw-s ara yettekkar uɣbalu. Sers-it ddaw n wayen yesɛan ṣṣut afessas akk i tebɣiḍ ad tesleḍ.

column1: The level it starts working at. Lower catches more of the performance.
column2: Aswir anda ara yebdu axeddim. Azal ameẓyan yeṭṭef ugar n wurar.

column1: The plugin's first four automatable controls, in its own order. Everything else it has keeps whatever the plugin was left set to.
column2: Ukkuẓ n yisenqaden imezwura iwurmanen n uzegrir, s umseḍfer-is. Ayen-nniḍen yeṭṭef iɣewwaren ineggura n uzegrir.

column1: Tints the two directions apart, so light bending one way and the other are different colours instead of both being grey.
column2: Yesmgirid ini n snat n tnila, tafat yekknen deg yal tnila tesɛa ini-nniḍen deg umkan n uɣiɣdan i snat.

column1: Turns the strokes across the grain instead of along it, which combs the picture apart rather than smoothing it.
column2: Yezzi izirigen ɣef uɛeqqa deg umkan ad t-ḍefren, iferreq tugna am umšan deg umkan n ulwiɣ.

column1: Turns the whole arrangement, so the fold lines do not sit on the same part of the picture all night.
column2: Yezzi tuddsa akk, i wakken izirigen n uḍewwal ur qqimen ara deg yiwen n wadeg n tugna iḍ akk.

column1: Where highlights fold back through black. Low folds most of the picture, high folds only the brightest.
column2: Anda ara ttuɣalen yiḥricen iceɛlen s uberkan. Azal ameẓyan yeḍwi tugna s umata, ameqqran yeḍwi kan aceɛlal akk.

column1: Where the band sits, 30Hz to 16kHz across the travel.
column2: Anda yella uḥzam, seg 30Hz ar 16kHz deg umecwar.

column1: Where the fold sits: the middle at the left, toward the far edge to the right. Flips have no fold.
column2: Anda yella uḍewwal: talemmast deg uzelmaḍ, ar yiran ibeɛden deg ufus. Tuzzya ur tesɛi ara aḍewwal.

column1: Where the light stands, in degrees around the frame.
column2: Anda tebna tafat, s tfessatin i d-yezzin i tugna.

column1: Where the source sits around the listener, all the way round. For headphones -- it is a timing and shading trick, not a pan.
column2: Anda yella uɣbalu i d-yezzin i win isellen, ɣef wannuz akk. I yimesfliden -- d taḥraymit n wakud d tili, mačči d pan.

column1: Where the top ends, 200Hz to 20kHz. Pull it down to take the harshness off a bright source.
column2: Anda yekfa ṣṣut ɛlayen, 200Hz ar 20kHz. Senɣes-it i tukksa n ṣṣut aquran seg uɣbalu aceɛlal.

column1: Which channel the curve acts on: all three, then red, green or blue on its own -- the way a colourist warms or cools one end of the picture.
column2: Anwa abadu i tɛedda teẓrigt: tlata, syen azeggaɣ, azegzaw neɣ anili iman-is -- am win n yiniten i yesḥemmu neɣ yessismiḍ yiwet n tama n tugna.

column1: Which way the knife edge lies. Only gradients ACROSS the edge show, so turning it swaps which features appear and which vanish.
column2: Anida tella tnila n yiri n tfriwt. Kan ibeddilen i yeɛdlen s AZURAN n yiri i d-yettbanen, ihi tuzzya tbeddel iferdisen i d-yettbanen d wid yettɣaben.

column1: Which way the streak runs: across at the left, upright in the middle, across again at the right.
column2: Tanila n uziri: s tehri deg uzelmaḍ, s teɣzi deg tlemmast, s tehri tikkelt-nniḍen deg ufus.

column1: Widens the decision into a ramp, so edges keep their shape instead of jagging.
